facts.fact: NewsWatch states that CAMTEL owns and operates Cameroon's national fibre-optic backbone of over 15,000 km; the article gives no regions or towns and no in-service date, so the date is the article's own (2026-07-27).

NewsWatch states that CAMTEL leases capacity on its national fibre-optic backbone to private mobile network operators, while holding exclusive rights over the backbone itself; the date is the article's own (2026-07-27).
